title: Looking at Coins
short: Look at coins and count pennies.

blocks.html: Coins are small round pieces of money. The penny is copper-colored. The nickel, dime and quarter are silver. The quarter is the biggest!

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: A penny, a nickel, a dime and a quarter.

blocks.html: Coins look different: different colors and different sizes.

For the grown-up: Look at real coins together, sort them by color and size, and count pennies into a jar. Small coins can be a choking hazard, so stay close and put them away after. A few problems on the screen is plenty. The real practice is with things you can touch.

items: Try it at home: Sort coins into piles that look alike.
Play store with pennies and toys.
